_readme: Ground truth for the test-images/ OCR bench.
IMPORTANT: `expected` is what is ACTUALLY RENDERED in each image, not the
idiomatic phrase the image was meant to show. These images were AI-generated
and several contain near-miss glyphs (因書館 instead of 図書館, 移了 instead of
終了, てす without dakuten instead of です, ましよう with a large よ). Scoring
against the corrected phrase would report permanent false failures.
The files are JPEG data with a .png extension — read them as buffers, never
infer the format from the extension.
`lang` is what to pass to setSourceLang(). `alsoTestAuto` marks the cases
worth re-running under 'auto', which is the path the v3.13.15 const bug broke.
`notes` records why a case is hard, and `knownUnreadable` marks text that no
OCR can recover (e.g. glyphs cropped by the image border).
`group` splits the bench for the OCR-refinement round (v3.13.77+): 'cjk' is
the original 12-image set (all ja/zh/ko/lzh); 'latin' is the synthetic
en-VN-dialogue set from scripts/gen-ocr-latin-images.js, authored at
app-realistic, DELIBERATELY non-multiple-of-32 sizes (the cjk set's sizes
all happen to land on or near a multiple of 32, which makes it blind to the
anisotropic-resize/scalar-ratio bug); 'real' is real screenshots from Lyca's
own VN sessions, added when available. Report mean similarity PER GROUP, not
just overall — a mixed mean can hide a cjk regression behind a latin gain.

images.expected: こんにちの世界
images.notes: High contrast, light background. Baseline sanity check. Note the rendered text is こんにちの世界, NOT こんにちは世界.

images.expected: 今天天气很好
images.notes: Clean simplified Chinese, native to the default zh model.

images.expected: 안녕하시오
images.notes: The reported Korean issue. The zh model has no hangul in its dictionary, so under 'auto' this triggers the model switch — the exact path the const bug made return empty. Glyphs are very large (~400px tall).

images.expected:
私は学生てす。
毎日学校に行きます。
images.notes: Semi-transparent dialogue box over a background. White text with outline. てす has no dakuten in the source.

images.expected:
ばじめから
つづきから
設定
因書館
移了
images.notes: Black background, white glow text, 5 separate regions. Near-miss glyphs: 因 not 図, 移 not 終, ばじめから not はじめから. The ▶ menu cursor is intentionally stripped by _cleanPaddleOcrText and is not in the expected text.

images.expected: 今日は良い天気てすわ
images.notes: Vertical single column on the right side. Very noisy dark background. Portrait 768x1344. Exercises isVerticalText() + rotate90CCW() and the vertical reading order fixed in Phase 0.

images.expected:
東京タワーへ行きましよう
Let's go to Tokyo Tower
入場料は大人1000円です
images.notes: Mixed JA/EN/digits. Phase 3 per-region script detection targets this: a Latin line sits between two Japanese ones. ましよう uses a large よ, not the small ょ.

images.expected:
秀太郎
どこへ行くの?
美咲
因書館に本を返しに行くの。
images.notes: Dark scene, 2 speaker labels + 2 bubbles = 4 regions whose order and association must survive. _mergeNearbyBoxes only merges horizontally today, so labels stay detached from their bubble (Phase 3). 因 not 図.

images.expected:
HP: 100/100
MP: 50/50
たたかう
まほう
にげる
どうく
images.notes: Pixel font, dark background, ~7 scattered regions. The yellow katakana is CROPPED BY THE RIGHT IMAGE BORDER — unrecoverable, so it is excluded from `expected` and listed under knownUnreadable. どうく is likely meant to be どうぐ. Pixel fonts have diagonal-only glyph connections, which 4-connectivity flood fill fragments (Phase 2).

images.expected: 遅れました
images.notes: The reported low-quality issue. Heavy sensor-style noise over a near-black background, 864x1152 (below maxSideLen 1280, so it is not even upscaled today). Primary target for CLAHE + autoInvert in Phase 1.

images.expected:
漢字の上にぶりが
ながあります
images.notes: The reported furigana issue. Small kana above 漢 and 上. These must NOT appear in the output — they are listed under `furigana` so the bench can score them as false positives if they leak in. minRegionArea 100 currently discards them before they can even be filtered geometrically.

images.expected:
學而時瞀之，不亦説乎？
不亦説乎？有朋自遠方來，
不亦樂乎？學而時時
阴時 祒時
images.notes: The reported classical Chinese issue. Traditional/classical glyphs read by a SIMPLIFIED model (lzh maps to zh). The trailing 學而時時/阴時/祒時 are degenerate repetitions in the source image, not OCR errors. Several glyphs are genuinely ambiguous at this resolution — score by similarity, never exact match.

images.expected: I never thought I'd see you again.
images.notes: 600x122, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. Tight VN dialogue box, white text on a dark semi-transparent bar — the capture window closely matches the text bounding box. Control image for the padding A/B: same text and font size as lat02, minimal empty margin.

images.expected: I never thought I'd see you again.
images.notes: 1200x400, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. IDENTICAL text and font size to lat01, rendered inside a much larger, mostly-empty capture region — this is Lyca's reported complaint reproduced directly. Compare lat01 vs lat02 similarity as the A/B pair; the gap between them is the number the round's Stage 2 fix must close.

images.expected: The old library still smelled of dust and rain.
images.notes: 900x150, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. Black serif text on a plain white background — the Ren'Py default dialogue look, unlike the dark boxes elsewhere in this group.

images.expected: Are you sure about this?
images.notes: 1000x220, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. White text with a dark outline/shadow over a busy noisy gradient background — stresses both engines' handling of low local contrast.

images.expected:
Maya
Don't wait up for me tonight.
images.notes: 800x180, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. Speaker name label above a dialogue line — 2 separate regions whose order and association must survive, same shape of problem as test08 but in Latin script.

images.expected: You should get some rest before tomorrow.
images.notes: 600x122, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. Small 12px font — exercises the Stage 3 detMinSideLen upscale path; the cjk group's smallest maxSide is 1152, well above the 960 floor, so only this image and the padding sweep can validate that change.

images.expected: "Wait—don't go," she said, her voice barely a whisper.
images.notes: 900x150, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. Curly quotes, an em dash, mixed case and digits — Latin punctuation the cjk group never exercises.

images.expected:
New Game
Continue
Settings
Gallery
Quit
images.notes: 1000x300, generated by gen-ocr-latin-images.js. 5 short scattered UI labels — exercises _mergeNearbyBoxes (must NOT merge unrelated labels) and maxRegions:15 in a large, mostly-empty capture region, same shape of problem as test09's RPG battle menu but in Latin script.
